theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) → (∀ i, A i ⊆ M) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → μHE[n] (M \ ⋃ i, A i) = 0 → LipschitzWith Λ φ → Injective φ → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in φ '' M, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∑' i, ∫⁻ y in φ '' A i, g y ∂μHE[n]
